name: sikick
description: Turn Claude Code sessions into SiKick work: link the session to the fitting card on My day, track worked time on it, then mark it done or worked on and turn follow-ups into cards you pick

sikick_url.title: SiKick address
sikick_url.description: Base address of your SiKick (https, no trailing slash). The SIKICK_URL environment variable wins over this.

mcp_url.title: SiKick account MCP address
mcp_url.description: The account MCP server (my_day, my_cards, search …). Change it together with the SiKick address.

suggest_cards.title: Suggest a card at session start
suggest_cards.description: On: at the start of a session SiKick suggests the card on My day that fits this folder / branch (matched on your computer); answer with one key. Off: link with /sikick:start only.

send_prompts.title: Also send prompt text
send_prompts.description: Off by default: SiKick gets only session, folder, tool names, changed file paths and times. Turn on to also send what you type (first 4000 characters).
